basis: F0 seed-3 fixed epoch-0 predictions are scored on the already-exposed source-qualified 468-component fold-0 development panel.

prediction.root_semantics: pinned copy honors WNN_PROJECT_ROOT=MAIN; because it runs from ops/scripts it imports the frozen R2 trainer from this same worktree.
prediction.pinned_copy_delta: Byte-identical production prediction path plus a resource-only first-16-sequence profiling flag; the flag is absent from all quality exports.

score_fold0_panel.execution_requirement: invoke this exact MAIN path; its ROOT is Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] and must remain MAIN

evaluate_bandit_continuation.role: score_fold0_panel imports its prediction-sidecar validator and paired component bootstrap from MAIN/scripts

evidence_limit: Repeatedly inspected fold-0 development evidence; not a fresh holdout or public-score forecast.
